latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free YouTube Free — Download YouTube Videos as MP4.

- Lets you download YouTube videos as high-quality MP4 files for free via a simple prompt.
- No account required: automatically fetches a free token and session for first-time users (with 100 free credits, valid 7 days).
- Upload or paste YouTube links; supports MP4, MOV, WebM, and AVI files up to 500MB.
- All interactions (download, export, credits, session status) managed via a cloud rendering pipeline, typically completing in 20–40 seconds.
- Clear error handling and step-by-step user feedback without exposing raw API details.
